authority_model.universe: Lean source and its import/argument graph
authority_model.rule: Papers explain, Comparator replays selected exact interfaces, and Palomar may review a prepared unit. None widens Lean's proposition or records peer review/acceptance unless its own source says so.

route_contract.rule: All generated routes are relative to lean/experience/. Absolute source_github routes always identify the canonical public source.

frontend_handoff.paper_math_preference: native MathML with exact TeX/MathJax fallback

performance_contract.delivery: pre-generated static JSON and HTML; no runtime repository analysis
performance_contract.render_cache: content-addressed by source hash, renderer version, and Pandoc version
performance_contract.frontend_expectation: fetch manifest first, then only the selected problem or overlay
